items.question: By what count and in what locations are certain beings said to endure torment in this enumeration?
premises: Eighty-four is given as a fixed numerical count.
Thousands are specified as the measure of those locations.
Womb-diagrams are named as the specific locations in question.
Those present in those locations are described as tormented.
items.inference: A total of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are the locations in which those beings are tormented.
uncertainties: The identity of the beings tormented is not specified by these tokens alone.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are the places where they are tormented.
